svg.aria-label: Celestia architecture: app.py mission controls feed physics.py (mass ratio, Lagrange points, stability), then rebound_sim.py integrates with IAS15, frames.py converts to the rotating frame, and the result fans out to viz.py interactive views, telemetry, and manim_viz.py cinematic export; shipped via Docker on Render, PyInstaller releases and GitHub Actions.
svg.text: From two masses to a cinematic orbit
